description:
Closes GitHub #305 and fz-sc8.85.

Delete the uniform calling tier from native codegen. cont_param becomes ir::Value (not Option), so the null-slot heap halt closure in resolve_outer_cont cannot be written.

Removed (the step 1 rows of the page's removal ledger):
- native_codegen/call.rs (182 lines).
- 25 functions: emit_halt_from_codegen_value, emit_return, emit_halt_and_return_null, emit_call, emit_tail_call, single_scalar_return_repr, build_fn_sigs, body_fn_id, alloc_frame, store_frame_value_dynamic, store_frame_word, store_bindings_into_callee_frame, store_typed_args_into_callee_frame, build_uniform_sig, callee_is_native, spec_fn_id, spec_is_native, uses_heap_closure, native_call_result_value, scalar_body_return_repr, scalar_or_never_body_return_halt_repr, emit_return_term, emit_native_call_with_cont, emit_native_tail_call, the uniform variant of emit_resume_closure.
- Constant HEADER_SIZE and the module doc describing uniform frames (rewritten to the planned convention).
- 8 fields: native_abi_fns, cont_target_fns, halt_reprs (each in surface and env), frame_ptr, host_ctx (harness output).
- 47 parameters (frame_ptr 18, is_native 14, host_ctx 5, schemas 8, cont_ptr_known_null 2) and the Option on cont_param at 16 sites.
- The null-slot heap halt closure and the always-None outer_cont_override and block_env.
- Test row 'a uniform trampoline body' (driver_test.rs:17).
- Doc sentences describing the frame ABI: .agent/docs/any-value.md:198 ('typed frame slots'), .agent/docs/externs.md:188 ('a frame allocation').

Kept: halt_cont_ref, the four static halt objects, emit_halt_cont_bodies, the entry-thunk kind select, return_tuple_arity (native_return_halt_repr, delivery.rs:36, still reads it; fz-sc8.85's note that it dies is wrong).

Starting point: scratchpad gh305b/spike-2-delete.patch applies cleanly to d2ecc9d48.

Done when: the rows above are gone; resolve_outer_cont has no allocation; a grep of .agent, guides, README.md and fixtures for resolve_outer_cont, native_abi_fns, build_uniform_sig and 'uniform tier' is clean.

Acceptance: fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --workspace --all-targets --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1 and --doc pass with the same counts and NO pin edit; emitted CLIF for JIT and AOT and normalised AOT disassembly identical to the parent commit over the 42-fixture set. the_halt_continuations_live_in_read_only_memory (drive_test.rs:10701) keeps the static objects pinned. No 'does not allocate' test: the path no longer exists; the evidence is the type plus identical output.
title: The planned ABI is the only calling tier
